comment:
Which bundle each audience gets.
version — what THIS build publishes. Bump it whenever web code changes, and only then. It is the identity of the code, so it must not move for any other reason.
public  — the version everyone gets. Point it at any still-hosted version to release or roll back.
beta    — null by DEFAULT: there is no beta, and opted-in devices get the public release like everyone else. Set it to a version only while something is actually being tested. Promoting that version is then `public: <same number>, beta: null` — the number never changes, because the code did not, so nothing needs retesting and the baseline is a state you can return to.
minNative — the lowest APK versionName this bundle runs on. Raise it in the same commit that makes web code depend on something new in the native shell. The endpoint refuses to serve a bundle to an older APK, and the app tells the player to update from the store.
keep    — how many bundles stay hosted. Each deploy carries the previous ones forward from the live site so every listed version stays fetchable from the same origin.
delta   — true serves the per-file manifest, so an update costs only what changed rather than the whole bundle. Set false to fall back to the plain zip from the server side, without a new build, if the manifest path is ever suspected.
